subject: REWRITE statement
notes: kb/Work PB1195: the REWRITE of a record in a SAME RECORD AREA clause makes it available in the other records of the area through the same two halves a READ uses - the shared character area when the released record is out of line, and every other out-of-line record (FileModel.OutOfLineRecordsOfArea) at its released length with its extent table - after a SUCCESSFUL statement (sequential and keyed emitters; WRITE and RELEASE share the store). Goldens: pb1195_released_record_also_available_out_of_line (sequential WRITE/REWRITE/READ and RELEASE) and pb1195_keyed_released_record_also_available (relative WRITE/REWRITE).
